intervention: At all six full-attention layers, only question/answer rows restrict historical keys to executable backward-slice event spans plus the instruction/chat prelude. All query and answer tokens retain causal access. GDN masks stay None.
notes: Exploratory frozen-checkpoint diagnostic on all 48 existing cases; no training or failure selection.
The complete original token stream, positions, prefix GDN computations and historical KV remain present.
All-history mask must exactly match unmodified scoring, greedy generation, logits and cache on a sampled query per checkpoint.
Restricted masks must preserve prefix cache/logits and historical KV in full prefill on a sampled query per checkpoint.
Dense eager masking is a causal diagnostic; it does not measure an efficient sparse implementation.
Success does not prove GDN state corruption; failure does not prove an irreversible information loss.
